quests.title: Counting Tracks
quests.summary: Help the conservation team on Ascension: meet a green turtle, then prove yourself to the Wideawake Warden.

steps.text: Catch a Cindershell and show it to the Conservation Officer in Georgetown.
Go and find the Wideawake Warden, east of the main road.
Win a battle against the Wideawake Warden, in the noise of the fair.
Report back to the Conservation Officer.

quests.reward: The Turtle Tag (a Tide charm), a Wahoo Steak and standing in the Overseas Territories.
